components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action with compact, consistent control height.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; font: 600 .875rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action on a neutral surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-heading); font: 600 .875rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-muted); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Semantic destructive action; use only when an operation is destructive.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--color-danger); color: #fff; font: 600 .875rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color .15s ease; } .ds-button-danger:hover { background: var(--color-danger-hover); } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-danger) 22%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard operational text entry with visible focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" type="text" aria-label="Buscar productos" placeholder="Buscar productos">
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-heading); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-primary); outline: 0; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); } .ds-field:disabled { background: var(--color-surface-muted); opacity: .65; }

components.name: Information Badge
components.description: Compact contextual status or category label.
components.css: .ds-badge-info { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: .2rem .5rem; background: var(--color-primary-soft); color: var(--color-primary-hover); font: 800 .68rem/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Grouped operational information on a quiet surface.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle); border-radius: .75rem; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, .05); } .ds-card strong { color: var(--color-heading); font: 600 1rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: .5rem 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Grouped navigation item with a clear selected state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem .75rem; border-radius: .5rem; color: var(--color-muted); font: 600 .875rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--color-surface-muted); color: var(--color-heading); } .ds-nav-link-active { background: var(--color-primary-soft); color: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: var(--focus-ring); }

narrative.overview:
Mauricio is a clear, professional, familiar workspace for people completing many ERP tasks. Its structure stays compact and predictable so product, price, inventory, and sales information remain easy to scan. The interface serves daily operations; it should not take on the voice or composition of a marketing page.

The default Azul ERP theme pairs a practical blue action color with cool, light neutrals. Users can select among ten color themes and switch between light and dark modes. Controls use visible state changes, concise labels, and a consistent hierarchy. Surfaces rely on thin borders with restrained shadows to distinguish working areas.
keyCharacteristics: Themeable color accents over stable neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The Theme Role Rule
rules.body: Preserve semantic color roles when the user selects another theme; do not hard-code the default blue into new themed components.

dos: Do keep operational information compact, scannable, and grouped by task.
Do retain the familiar neutral surfaces and express theme choice through semantic color roles.
Do make active, hover, focus, error, disabled, and loading states visibly distinct.
Do adapt dense tables and navigation for touch-width screens.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and accessible labels on icon-only controls.
donts: Don't turn operational screens into marketing pages or decorative dashboards.
Don't use color alone to explain status or selection.
Don't replace the compact operational hierarchy with oversized display typography or oversized empty space.
Don't use shadows as the only boundary between related surfaces.
